hooks.name: Validate DQPT on trajectory creation
hooks.description: When a new DQPT trajectory NPZ is created in data/dqpt_trajectories/, automatically runs validate_dqpt_results to give instant feedback on physics checks.

action.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import sys,json,re; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); sys.path.insert(0,'src'); stdin_data=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}; path=stdin_data.get('filePath',''); m=re.search(r'([a-z_]+)_N',path); topo=m.group(1) if m else 'heavy_hex'; from scripts.analysis.validate_dqpt_results import validate_dqpt_topology; r=validate_dqpt_topology(topo); n_pass=sum(1 for c in r.checks if c.passed); print(json.dumps({'topology':topo,'n_trajectories':r.n_trajectories,'checks_passed':n_pass,'checks_total':len(r.checks),'overall_pass':r.overall_pass}))"
